metadata.title: Policy Alignment Remediation: Stage 4 Threshold Config + systemd hardening
metadata.description: Retroactive remediation to bring an unauthorized edit sequence into policy alignment via explicit documentation, approval gating, and an auditable change matrix. Expanded scope includes a deterministic implementation drift audit (SSOT vs docs, scheduler integrity, contract naming drift) with evidence captured under local_untracked/.

incident.summary: ORACL-Prime performed configuration/code edits during a session explicitly constrained to analysis-only mode.

objectives: Document the policy deviation and rationale for the changes
Record an explicit approval gate and verification steps
Ensure Stage 4 threshold is configurable via environment variables in a safe, namespaced way
Ensure systemd services support EnvironmentFile-based configuration (no secrets embedded)
Add systemd hardening directives in a minimal, auditable manner
Implement and run an offline implementation drift audit; record outputs and findings in the execution report
